reason: A proposes a concrete, falsifiable thermomechanical treatment with an experimentally demonstrated strength–ductility improvement in AlCoCrFeNi2.1 and directly measures pile-ups and boundary cracking, although it is technically a two-step processing route and some boundary/short-range-order claims are overstated. B’s premise that annealing can selectively create beneficial boundary incoherency or controlled decohesion while preserving strength is unsupported and potentially counterproductive because weakened or incoherent interfaces may promote cracking rather than absorb dislocations.
